description:
Adds SQLite support for the following function :

* [json_valid(json,flags)](https://sqlite.org/draft/json1.html#jvalid)

Partially completes https://github.com/diesel-rs/diesel/issues/4366

comments.body:
I think I would prefer a more strictly typed approach here. That means:

1. Define a new SQL type in https://github.com/diesel-rs/diesel/blob/main/diesel/src/sqlite/types/mod.rs. That should use `#[diesel(sqlite_type(name = "Integer"))`
2. Define an enum with all the variants listed above (marked as `#[non_exhaustive]`
3. Implement `ToSql<YourNewSqlType, Sqlite>` for that enum + derive `AsExpression` for it.
4. Use this new defined sql type here in place of `Integer`

I think we can make the return type not-nullable for not-nullable inports.

That would require:

1. Changing the bound to `X: TextOrNullableTextOrBinaryOrNullableBinary + SingleValue +  MaybeNullableValue<Bool>`
2. Changing the return type to `X::Out`
3. Changing the tests to use `bool` for non-nullable inputs
I think these are not required as we don't need to be backward compatible with the old PR version
